title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Renewal, Escalation and Cancellation Terms
content:
**Clause 1.** Each program of the Demand Service Rate Programs states whether it renews automatically at the end of its
term. The renewal window is the number of calendar days before term end at which the renewal window
opens, and the non-renewal notice the number of calendar days before term end by which a non-renewal
notice must be received.

**Clause 2.** The escalation is the escalation applied to the labor rate at each renewal, in percent.

**Clause 3.** The cancellation notice is the number of calendar days of written notice before a
cancellation takes effect, and the cancellation fee the fee charged when the program is cancelled before
its term end, in US dollars.

| Program | Renews automatically | Renewal window (calendar days before term end) | Non-renewal notice (calendar days before term end) | Escalation at renewal (percent) | Cancellation notice (calendar days) | Cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | Yes | 30 | 15 | 5 | 15 | 0 |
| Priority Response Program | Yes | 45 | 30 | 4.5 | 30 | 250 |
| Block Hour Service Program | Yes | 45 | 30 | 4 | 30 | 0 |
| Emergency Response Program | Yes | 60 | 30 | 3.5 | 60 | 900 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | Yes | 90 | 60 | 3 | 90 | 2500 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | No | 120 | 90 | 3 | 120 | 6500 |

**Clause 4.** The Dedicated Technician Program is the one program in the table that does not renew
automatically. The Time & Material Account and the Block Hour Service Program carry a cancellation fee
of 0 US dollars.
